scope: CPU-only source and proof-consumer review. No GPU, HTTP, service, or compile was started.

observations.criterion: Formal-manifest parser consumes the established D04 artifact convention
observations.evidence: d10_v9_proofs.formal('E2-R067d-d20-short-tail-retry1') succeeded on the target host and returned canonical round, manifest, and history hashes. It correctly normalizes ./ entries and excludes round.json, MANIFEST.sha256, and round_history from the governed data set.

observations.criterion: V9 wrapper is a runnable V9 controller/child whose entrypoints, RID, RUNS, proof paths, and source map are unified
observations.evidence: V9 has no main() and no require_admission(). Executing `python d10_prototype_owned_parent_v9.py --filedry` returned exit 0 with empty stdout. It only exports V8 child/controller/filedry. Imported base RID remains E2-D10-PROTOTYPE-night-20261010-v8; child_argv points to d10_prototype_owned_parent_v8.py; filedry schema/source map are V8 and omit V9/proofs.

observations.criterion: Formal, cleanup, and native proofs gate runtime admission before controller/child execution
observations.evidence: require_formal_proofs() is a standalone unused function. V9 neither invokes it from an admission gate nor passes its result into borrowed V8 controller/child. Thus a V8 admission path can bypass every V9 proof even if the helper succeeds.

observations.criterion: V9 native proof consumes the real reuse receipt and regular extension bytes
observations.evidence: Actual proof.native() failed on the target host: RuntimeError unsealed /data2/FreeToken/wt/release-e2/python/freetoken/kernel/_cpu_moe.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so. The actual source/destination extensions are regular and hash-identical to reuse receipt but mode 0775, so V9's seal() rejects them before byte validation. The receipt did not exercise this helper.

observations.criterion: V9 cleanup proof consumes the real rootwatcher producer schema
observations.evidence: Actual proof.cleanup() on the sealed D09 rootwatcher readback raised KeyError('status'). The consumer expects x['status'], child_absent is True, and batch=144; actual readback carries actual_status, child_absent identity object, launch/status hashes, and owners. It remains incompatible with the producer.

observations.criterion: T16/D09 round semantics prove candidate, base, and default-off properties using the real formal producer schema
observations.evidence: round_semantics reads candidate_commit and parent_commit at the top level, while ft_round formal records place the candidate under experimental.candidate_commit and base commit under base.commit. Its T16 default-off check searches serialized JSON for Python spelling False, but JSON serializes booleans as false. Thus a correctly formed future formal proof will not be consumed, and any incidental string False would be an unsound substitute for a named default-off source/config binding.

v8_body_boundary.evidence: The previously independent V8 same-body CPU checks remain evidence about the borrowed V8 body only. V9 has no executable wrapper path and does not bind V9/proof hashes into that body, so they cannot establish V9 runtime readiness.

current_state.result: These pending proofs are not a failure by themselves. The V9 integration and actual native/cleanup consumer failures independently block readiness.

required_repair: Implement a V9 main/controller/owned-child path. Set one V9 RID/RUNS/child_argv and execute V9 proof-gated admission before any V8-derived body action.

Bind V9 wrapper, d10_v9_proofs.py, V8 body, V8 transitive runtime sources, runner/parser/frozen inputs, native provenance/reuse receipt, admission schema, and root receipt in the active V9 source map and filedry output.
Make cleanup() consume the actual rootwatcher schema and canonical retry1 paths: identity object in child_absent, launch/status hashes, actual status RID/batch/verdict, owners, and cleanup_ok.

Make native() consume the real regular-file policy safely: verify reuse receipt schema/candidate/base/no-source-diff/not-compiled and all declared extension hashes/sizes. Resolve the immutable-file policy without treating currently verifiable regular source/destination extensions as an unexplained proof failure.

Read the actual formal schema fields (experimental.candidate_commit and base.commit) and replace the T16 substring default-off check with named formal fields and exact source/config hashes. Add CPU tests that invoke the real V9 entrypoint and prove wrong candidate, proof path, manifest/history tamper, cleanup identity, native replacement, branch event, receipt scope, and partial-call behavior are rejected through the active V9 path.
Issue a new immutable V9 receipt only after those tests and a fresh independent review.
